name: Kitpas Rice Bran Wax Crayon 16 Colours
description: Crayons with a difference. The Medium 16 Rice Bran Colours by kitpas are water-soluble, eco-friendly creative sticks. They're perfect for drawing on paper or card, but also work great on other fun surfaces - like windows, for stained-glass inspired art. If they want to try their hands at painting, simply dip the tips and they turn into watercolours, for more richly-coloured masterpieces. The large chunky form is great for little hands to grip onto and they don't crumble easily; so they're an ideal craft box addition.
